Name: howl's farmdog retexture
Author: dognamedhowl
Description:
[size=4][b]In memoriam.[/b][/size]
On the evening of Friday, July 31st, 2026, the dog I grew up with ended his time on this Earth with us. I made this mod for myself, and for my younger siblings, for us to keep him with us. Since he was such a good boy (and so handsome!), I thought I'd post him here for anyone who would like to offer him a place on their farm. ♥ His name was Jecht, after the Final Fantasy character, because our mother is a terminal nerd.

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simply extract the .zip file and place the folder inside in your Mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI 4.5.2+ and Content Patcher 2.9.0+.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout Outs:[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I heavily referenced Elle's dog retextures, to such an extent that the linework on the legs lines up in places. I would be remiss not to provide credit to them. Go check out their stuff![/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I've attached some pictures of my boy; two from when he was about 8-9 years old, and the last one more recent, taken at 12 years of age.[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Howl's Dog Retexture - Jecht
Manifest.Description: A memorial mod for my childhood dog, who ended his time on this Earth the evening of July 31st, 2026. Made primarily for personal use for myself and my siblings, but happily shared with anyone who sees his charm, even in pixel form.
Manifest.Author: dognamedhowl
